FIELDS.NAME: Eternal Rest Funeral Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Eternal Rest Funeral Services, we provide compassionate funeral and cemetery services tailored to meet the diverse needs of families during their most challenging times. Our operations encompass a full range of services, including traditional funerals, memorials, cremation, and burial arrangements. We prioritize quality and respect in all our interactions, ensuring that every service reflects the personal values and wishes of the deceased and their loved ones. 

Our team consists of licensed funeral directors and trained staff who are dedicated to guiding families through the planning process with sensitivity and professionalism. We adhere to all local and state regulations, maintaining the necessary licenses and certifications for our operations. Safety and sanitation are paramount, and we implement comprehensive training programs for all employees to ensure compliance with health and safety standards throughout our services.

In addition to our core funeral offerings, our cemetery operations provide serene, well-maintained grounds for family members to honor their loved ones. We utilize established risk management practices and regularly review our procedures to maintain a safe environment, free from uncorrected fire code violations.

We work with carefully vetted subcontractors for specialized services, ensuring all contractual agreements outline clear liabilities and responsibilities. This structural integrity helps safeguard our commitment to quality and offers peace of mind to the families we serve. Our commitment to ongoing training and adherence to best practices in all of our operations reinforces our reputation as a reliable provider of funeral and cemetery services.

Our cemetery and funeral services occasionally involve the preparation of remains in a manner that may include the use of unconventional techniques to ensure that families receive a presentation that meets their expectations.

FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Eternal Rest Funeral Services does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of our operations. We adhere to safety and regulation standards to ensure a safe environment for all services provided.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Eternal Rest Funeral Services does not sponsor athletic teams as part of its operations, focusing solely on providing funeral and cemetery services.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. Certificates are checked by our operations team to ensure compliance and proper risk management.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions related to fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with our operations or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Eternal Rest Funeral Services has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. All coverage has been maintained during this period.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Eternal Rest Funeral Services does not lease employees to or from other employers, as we maintain a dedicated team within our operations to ensure quality and consistency in our services.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Coverage is excluded for claims arising from intentional acts or gross negligence, which means that if there are unintentional issues, they would not be covered under the current policy. Therefore, it is important to ensure compliance with all safety and operational standards to mitigate risks.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Eternal Rest Funeral Services does not own or operate any other business. Our focus is solely on providing dedicated funeral and cemetery services to our community.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Eternal Rest Funeral Services does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. All coverage is currently maintained under a single policy.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Eternal Rest Funeral Services does not engage in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products as part of its operations. Our focus is entirely on providing compassionate funeral and cemetery services to families.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Eternal Rest Funeral Services does not rent or loan equipment to others, as we prioritize safety and compliance in our operations. This helps prevent any potential liabilities associated with equipment usage.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Eternal Rest Funeral Services has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years, ensuring a stable financial standing.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Eternal Rest Funeral Services does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as part of our operations. We prioritize safety and adhere to all relevant regulations to maintain a secure environment for our services.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Coverage is excluded for claims arising from intentional acts or gross negligence, which includes potential catastrophe exposure.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – There have been no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We prioritize compliance and uphold high ethical standards in our operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Eternal Rest Funeral Services does not have any uncorrected fire code violations, and all necessary corrections have been made to ensure safety and compliance with regulatory standards.
